make_dmlab_env: create a DeepMind Lab Gym environment instance for a named DMLab task using the provided config
dmlab_env_by_name: look up a DmLabSpec by environment name from the predefined DMLAB_ENVS list or parse an unknown name
list_all_levels_for_experiment: list all DMLab levels associated with a given experiment environment name
get_task_id: compute the task ID for a given environment config, spec, and config to distribute tasks across workers
ensure_initialized: initialize DMLab models and level cache before creating environments, registering extra stats processing for dmlab_30
